A.best_shot: feature-shots seed 2, the pour over the cave mouth
A.why: The cave lintel and meltwater column are good parts, but the ice is a field of boxes, the pool does not glow, and every seed is the same notch with a T road.

B.best_shot: feature-shots seed 2, the crossing from the south
B.why: A readable bridge over a dark cut with a lit seam from above and real variety in cut shapes; the bridge itself never changes and the eye-level shots are cluttered.

C.best_shot: feature-shots seed 2, the well from the snow
C.why: The aurora column is the best effect in the run and the dark collar now reads as a shaft; clutter on the rim and the spire blocking the game camera hold it back.

D.best_shot: feature-shots seed 3, the field from the south-east
D.why: Fins are now near-black prows with tails and an arch, and the seeds vary most in count and threading; flanks still read as stacked cubes and the game camera sees a black wall.

E.why: Good steam column and one good vent shot, but the crown shots are a forest of blocks with no vent visible and every seed is the same central cluster.

F.best_shot: feature-shots seed 1, the wreck from the ice
F.why: The tilted longship is the strongest subject in the run, its glow is now a tight keel line, and the ship states vary; the lake surface is still noisy.

G.best_shot: feature-shots seed 1, down the winding way
G.why: The light fans finally appear and read from the game camera, but the barrows remain crate piles and no photograph frames a lit door.

H.why: A strong axial nave with ruin and a good frost shaft, but every seed is the same cross plan turned, and the game camera is still blocked on two seeds.

shelf.F: A complete, instantly readable landmark with a working keel glow and varied wreck states; any frozen lake map can take it.
shelf.C: The aurora shaft is the best vertical effect and the well shapes vary enough to anchor a field's centre.
shelf.B: A crossing feature with real cut-shape variety and a readable bridge that solves 'how the road gets over' in many maps.
shelf.D: The seeds vary most of all and the dark prow with its arch and streaming spindrift is a distinct silhouette worth reusing.

notes: Final round, judged on the renders alone. F and C remain the two strongest; D made the largest gain this round (near-black, fewer, shaped fins). G answered its main point (the fans) but its barrows still fail. E regressed in its eye-level shots. A answered the serac framing but still lacks its glowing pool. H answered the ruin but its plan is one layout rotated. Weights: idea 3, photo 2.5, topology 2, look 1, camera 0.75, usable 0.75.
